name: Mo
source: Mo’s active and endlessly curious. They’re always up for adventure: climbing, playing, wrestling, dancing … but also easily become restless. They will do their best to surprise you, and you’ll never know who’ll be bottom or top. They’re seldom at home - at least not alone. If you need someone to cheer you up, Mo is there for you.
